class.name: Tiles3DOptions
class.brief_description: Controls the coordinate frame of streamed 3D Tiles datasets.
class.description: Assign to [member TiledMeshInstance3D.format_options] to select the [code]3dtiles[/code] adapter. Supports explicit 3D Tiles 1.0/1.1 tilesets, external tilesets, multiple contents, static glTF 2.0/GLB, b3dm, composite tiles containing supported models, and [code]KHR_draco_mesh_compression[/code]. Implicit tiling, i3dm, pnts, skinning, and unsupported required extensions report an error. Tile transforms and source positions use double precision. Meshes are rebased before conversion to engine coordinates. glTF Y-up coordinates are converted to the tileset's Z-up frame before applying tile transforms. Options are copied when a loading session starts; call [method TiledMeshInstance3D.reload] after changing them.

members.member: Determines the source-to-local coordinate frame. The default origin is the transformed root bounding volume center. Use [member TiledMeshInstance3D.world_origin_mode] to override the origin and [member TiledMeshInstance3D.unit_scale] to change units.

Cesium ion 资产 ID。大于 0 时通过官方 endpoint 异步加载托管的 3DTILES，覆盖 [member TiledMeshInstance3D.source_uri]；0 保持普通本地/HTTP 加载。需同时设置 [member ion_access_token]。不支持地形、影像、外部供应商或隐式切片；资产 Token 过期后可调用 [method TiledMeshInstance3D.reload]，尚不自动刷新或展示 attribution。
仅用于获取 ion endpoint 的用户访问 Token。建议运行时从环境变量注入并限制资产权限；密码显示不等于加密存储。返回的资产 Token 仅发送至同源 HTTPS 资产目录中的子资源，不发送至外部主机。不要提交真实 Token 到版本库。

constants.constant: Uses ECEF when the root bounding volume is a WGS84 region or its center is farther than 1,000,000 source units from zero; otherwise uses Cartesian Z-up. Override this heuristic for large Cartesian engineering datasets.
Maps source [code](X, Y, Z)[/code] to Godot [code](X, Z, -Y)[/code].
Treats source positions as WGS84 Earth-centered, Earth-fixed meters. Local X points east, Y points up, and negative Z points north at the root center.
